components.name: ICS-VEX Reverse SBOM Builder
components.description: Reverse-builds a CycloneDX SBOM-CVE per ICS device from the CISA ICS-CERT advisory corpus.

component.name: Siemens SIMATIC S7-1500 TM MFP Linux Kernel
component.description: ICS/OT asset 'SIMATIC S7-1500 TM MFP Linux Kernel' by Siemens, reverse-built from CISA ICS-CERT advisory icsa-23-166-11.

properties.name: ics:product
properties.value: SIMATIC S7-1500 TM MFP Linux Kernel

components.name: Siemens SIMATIC S7-1500 TM MFP - GNU/Linux subsystem <V1.1
components.description: Single product enumerated by the source CSAF product_tree; the advisory declares no model variants.

components.name: OpenSSL
components.description: TLS/SSL and general-purpose cryptography library. Handles the device's secure communication channels and certificate processing.

components.name: Linux Kernel
components.description: Device operating-system kernel. Provides scheduling, memory management, and the device-driver layer.

components.name: OpenSSH
components.description: SSH server/client used for remote management and secure file transfer.

components.name: GNU C Library
components.description: Standard C runtime and system-call wrappers used by applications.

components.name: SQLite
components.description: Embedded database engine for alarm history, trend buffers, and local configuration storage.
